data.title: Rotate the Point
data.statement:
You are given a point ([[x]], [[y]]) in the Cartesian plane and an angle [[a]].
Rotate the point around the origin (0, 0) by [[a]] degrees <<counterclockwise>>.

The angle is always a multiple of {{90°}}. You must output the coordinates of the point after the rotation.

NB: For rotations by multiples of {{90°}}, the coordinates can be obtained by swapping [[x]] and [[y]] and changing their signs when necessary.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You are given a point (x, y) in the Cartesian plane and an angle a.
Rotate the point around the origin (0, 0) by a degrees counterclockwise.

The angle is always a multiple of 90°. You must output the coordinates of the point after the rotation.

NB: For rotations by multiples of 90°, the coordinates can be obtained by swapping x and y and changing their signs when necessary.
Input
A single line containing three integers: x, y, a
Output
Print two integers separated by a space: x' y'

where (x', []y']]) are the coordinates of the point after the rotation.
Constraints
-10^9 ≤ x ≤ 10^9
-10^9 ≤ y ≤ 10^9
0 ≤ a ≤ 360
a is a multiple of 90.
Example
Input
3 2 90
Output
-2 3
